name: Luma AI
summary: Generative video and 3D creation company targeting visual storytelling workflows.
overview: Luma AI develops generative models for video and 3D content.
bull_case: Generative visual tools can widen content creation and accelerate production cycles.
bear_case: Model costs, copyright questions, and deep-pocketed rivals could impair margins.

intelligence.description: Luma AI develops generative video, 3D and multimodal world-model technology for creative and physical-world applications.
company: Luma started in visual capture and generative media, then broadened its ambition to multimodal models that can understand and simulate the physical world.
The company has said its Series C will support model training and deployment, including a planned compute partnership with Humain.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Luma sits where video generation, 3D tools and world models meet. That puts it in direct competition for creative workloads while also creating an option on robotics and simulation.

changed.text: Raised a $900M Series C to scale multimodal model development.
Focused its investment case on world models and large-scale compute deployment.

takeaways: Luma is extending beyond creator tools into multimodal AI.
Its funding supports unusually capital-intensive training ambitions.
The commercial question is whether its products convert technical novelty into durable workflows.
